about_the_game:
Ultimate Fishing® Online (Demo) is a free-to-play multiplayer fishing simulator that drops you into the peaceful waters of Cooter Pond. Join up to 16 players, master different techniques, and experience a reactive fishing world powered by weather and time-of-day systems.

This demo is a first cast - we invite you to try it, share your thoughts, and help us reel in the perfect fishing experience. Let's shape together the final version of the game!

Explore Cooter Pond

Grab your rod and explore Cooter Pond, a detailed U.S. fishery where each cast feels unique. Try float or spinning, and hook one of 10 playable species, including largemouth bass, pickerel, catfish, crappie, and bluegill.

Game Features:

  • 16-player multiplayer (public, friends-only, private)

  • Realistic fish behavior, including predators, omnivores, or herbivores

  • 10 fish species

  • Float & spinning 

  • Underwater camera to observe bait and fish reactions

  • Limited fishing gear catalog, including wear and tear system with repair mechanics

  • Dynamic weather and day/night cycle that impacts fish behavior

  • First-person and third-person camera options

  • Basic player customization and emote system

Please note: the game is still in development, and its features or gameplay may change as a result of further updates or community feedback.

The demo version has disabled microtransactions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F / AMD Ryzen 5 1600 AF
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
